title: 3 Apps You Can Build in Zoho CRM Just by Typing (Vibe) #Shorts
description:
Zoho's own examples for Vibe, the new prompt-to-app builder in Zoho CRM: a sales leaderboard (revenue, funnel, team ranks), an account management console (risk signals, renewals in the next 90 days) and a commission calculator (tiers, deal bonuses, live projected earnings). Available first on supported editions with the Manage Extensibility permission, rolling out in phases.

Sources (checked 25 Nov 2026):
- Zoho blog - Introducing Vibe: https://www.zoho.com/blog/crm/introducing-vibe-ai-app-builder-within-zohocrm.html
- Zoho Community - Introducing Vibe in CRM: https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/community/topic/introducing-vibe-in-zoho-crm-turn-your-ideas-to-live-experience

This video uses an AI-generated presenter (Google Flow) and animations; facts checked against the sources above. Independent channel, not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.
